mapper.select: select a.*, b.ACTUAL_COST as actualCost, b.SETTLEMENT_TYPE as settlementType, b.SITUATION_DESC as situationDesc, b.READJUST_REASON as readjustReason, b.PROOF_ATTACH as proofAttach, b.SN as confirmSn, b.MODEL_ID as confirmModelId, b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as confirmProcessInstanceId, b.STATUS as confirmStatus from BIZ_DEV_FORM a left join BIZ_DEV_CONFIRM b on a.ID = b.BIZ_DEV_FORM_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1') ${ew.customSqlSegment}
